_how: Copy to teardowns/<slug>/codebook.json. Fill aspects, personas and requests after reading low.txt and asks.txt. Keep ids short snake_case. Keep the generic fields as they are so results compare across apps.

aspects.core_loop: the main thing users do every session
aspects.pricing_access: objects to paying at all / wants a free tier
aspects.pricing_level: price too high / wants cheaper or one-time
aspects.dark_patterns: misleading paywall, false choice, hidden close, repeat paywalls, gimmick discounts
aspects.support: cannot reach a human, slow or no reply
aspects.nags: share, rate or upsell prompts during use
aspects.bugs: crashes, freezes, broken navigation, lost state
aspects.content_quality: accuracy, errors, depth of the content
